name: lunaferry.com
pitch: A clean, evocative two-word .com for cislunar logistics — the kind of name a moon-cargo or orbital-transfer company can build a brand on. Says what it does without being literal.

name: selenocentric.com
pitch: A real scientific term (selenocentric orbit: moon-centered, as geocentric is earth-centered). Precise vocabulary for a lunar navigation, mapping, or space-science venture.

name: singularon.com
pitch: A confident coined brandable in the singularity/AI register. Pronounceable on first hearing, spellable from speech, and free of the platform-prefix traps that plague AI naming.

name: orbiferry.com
pitch: Orbital ferry, compressed into a brandable. For in-space transfer, satellite servicing, or last-mile orbital delivery.

name: petaqubit.com
pitch: Peta-scale + qubit: the vocabulary of quantum computing at the scale it's heading toward. An early claim on a rising term.

name: orbitug.com
pitch: Orbital tug — the actual industry term for a spacecraft that moves other spacecraft between orbits. Short and on-vocabulary.
